notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (Python requests, Chrome UA impersonation) + bs4/regex HTML parsing. robots.txt checked first (https://www.ethanallen.com/robots.txt) - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, only pattern-based disallows (facet/query params, account/cart/checkout/search, a few named promo slugs) that do not cover any URL used here; tier (a) was sufficient, no block encountered, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: union of sitemap_1.xml (1023 URLs, filtered for textile/storage keywords) and the site's shared mega-menu (same header nav parsed off shop-decor, shop-bedding, shop-rugs-drapery 'Rugs & Flooring' and shop-outdoor-accessories pages) plus each leaf page's own canonical/h1 check to confirm no silent parent-number fallback. QTY: SFCC rendered 'N Results found' on each category/search page, read post-fetch (server-rendered, no JS needed). EXCLUDED: (1) all Storage-shaped items (bookcases, cabinets/chests, buffets/sideboards/servers, china/wine cabinets, file cabinets storage, 'North American Made Storage Furniture') are explicitly nested under the site's Furniture menu (shop-furniture-*-storage-display*) - per storage.md Sec21/27 site hierarchy rule these belong to Furniture.xlsx (already validated), not Storage, so storage_rows is empty for this company; (2) Decor>Decorative Accents>Baskets(7) and Boxes(11) - site places these under Decorative Accents, most product names are decorative (bone/capiz/leather/marquetry boxes, hand-woven decorative baskets) even though 1-2 basket SKUs are literally named 'Storage Basket'; per storage.md Sec5/23/24 (site hierarchy over keyword) these were left out of Storage and are covered by Decorative Home Accessories instead; (3) Drapery Hardware Sets (shop-decor-drapery-drapery-hardware) - curtain rods/hardware, excluded per textile.md Sec5; (4) Custom Window Treatments (shop-decor-custom-drapery, redirects to /custom-window-treatments) - 0 product tiles, no results-count, a consultation/lead-gen page not a listing page; (5) shop-rugs-all-rugs (141, 'Shop All Area Rugs') - View-All aggregator, excluded; (6) Luxury Vinyl Flooring - construction material, not textile; (7) shop-outdoor-rugs canonicalizes to shop-rugs-indoor-and-outdoor (same page/qty 19) - counted once under Rugs, not duplicated under Outdoor; (8) Outdoor Decor (4 items: garden stools/seats, glass jar), Umbrellas & Stands, Furniture Finish Samples - not textile/storage; (9) Wallpaper, Games, Mirrors, Artwork, Florals/Trees/Plants, Desk Accessories, and all other Decorative-Accents leaves (trays/bottles-jars/bowls/candle-holders/decorative-objects/planters-urns/vases) - Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor scope; (10) Sale/Clearance/What's-New pages (shop-sale-accents-*, shop-clearance-*, *-whats-new) and Buying Guide pages - promotional/informational, not category listings; (11) Furniture 'Fabrics & Leathers' swatch/upholstery-fabric-collection pages (shop-furniture-fabrics-and-leathers-fabric-collection-*) - these are upholstery swatch options for customizing furniture, not standalone home-textile products, so excluded from Textile. No bathroom-textile (towel/bath) categories exist on this site. Rug Pads (3, felt/rubber non-slip pads sold under the Rugs menu) kept but flagged LOW confidence - functional rug accessory, not itself a decorative/floor-covering textile product; ambiguous per textile.md Sec22.
